description: This file defines the TimezonesAPI class, which extends an Endpoint and implements CollectionEndpoint, providing an API interface to list available timezones with optional filtering by timezone name. It handles HTTP GET requests, fetching timezone data, formatting timezone offsets, and returning a sorted collection of timezones. The class uses traits for date and number utilities and includes OpenAPI annotations for documentation.
